resources.string: Create silent forward-and-reverse wallpaper videos. Saved templates stay on your device.
The app creates a new silent MP4 at the source resolution and stores it privately. The generated video is longer and uses extra space; delete templates you no longer need.
Select or create a wallpaper to calculate its colors.
The selected template’s colors are provided to Android as wallpaper colors. The system decides how and when to apply them to its theme.
No saved wallpapers yet. Create one from an MP4 to add it here.
Wallpaper template saved. It is ready to preview and set.
Could not create a wallpaper from this MP4. Check free storage and choose a supported video.
Could not save the wallpaper template. Please try again.
Android did not grant lasting access to this file. Please choose it again from the system file picker.
No compatible system file picker was found.
Create or select a saved wallpaper first.
The generated MP4 will be removed from app storage. The original video is not changed.
Play a saved silent MP4 wallpaper containing a forward-and-reverse loop, and share its sampled colors with Android.
